1010:017E.name: poll_control_keys_into_button_field
1010:017E.notes: Reads 8 scancodes from the control-map table at DS:213E (or DS:2146 when DS:[0010]==2), indexes the INT 9 key-state table at DS:98C4, shifts each key's pressed bit, and rcl-packs them into the button bitfield at DS:98BE. Active map DS:213E = [00,00,Z(2C),Space(39),Q(10),A(1E),O(18),P(19)]: OVERKILL uses Q/A/O/P to move + Z/Space to fire, not the arrow keys.

1010:0324.name: overkill_word_pair_rle_decoder_0324
1010:0324.notes: Word-pair RLE decoder. Reads a sentinel word through the packed 0615 stream reader, writes literal word pairs when the next word differs from the sentinel, and handles sentinel/count/pair repeated runs. Sentinel plus count zero exits to the shared loader dispatcher at 02A8. Verified against interpreted ASM with literal, repeat, terminator, flags, packed-stream scratch, and stack scratch coverage.

1010:0367.name: overkill_linear_byte_rle_decoder_0367_fast
1010:0367.notes: Linear/horizontal byte RLE decoder. Verified against interpreted ASM on synthetic literal/repeat/80h terminator stream; optimized to collapse runs while preserving tested final state.

1010:066B.name: timer_tick_flag
1010:066B.notes: Byte flag in the resident segment. Incremented by the game's reprogrammed IRQ0 ISR (via the 066C helper) and consumed only by the 0679 wait loop; cleared by 0672. Drives per-frame timing.

1010:066C.name: timer_tick_inc
1010:066C.notes: inc byte ptr cs:[066B]; ret. Called from the reprogrammed INT 08h ISR at 06E5 (site 0713) on alternating sub-ticks.

1010:0672.name: timer_tick_clear
1010:0672.notes: mov byte ptr cs:[066B],0; ret. Clears the tick flag before a wait. Callers: 97B2, D007, D318, D406 (each paired with a 0679 wait).

1010:0679.name: overkill_wait_timer_tick_0679
1010:0679.notes: Busy-wait: cmp byte cs:[066B],0; jz 0679; ret. Waits for the next reprogrammed-IRQ0 tick. Callers 981A/D025/D340/D41F. Replaced by a narrow hook modelling one elapsed tick (066B 0->1) since this interpreter delivers no async interrupts; verified against interpreted ASM.

1010:0682.name: install_timer_if_needed
1010:0682.notes: cmp word [0052],1; if not yet installed, fall through to 068A. [0052] is the timer-installed flag.

1010:068A.name: install_fast_timer_isr
1010:068A.notes: Saves old INT 08h vector to CS:0738/073A, reprograms 8253 PIT (out 43h,36h; divisor 0x4000 ~= 72.8 Hz), sets INT 08h -> 1010:06E5 via AH=2508h, sets [0052]=1.

1010:06BC.name: uninstall_fast_timer_isr
1010:06BC.notes: cmp word [0052],0; if installed, restore old INT 08h vector from CS:0738, reprogram PIT back to 18.2 Hz, EOI, clear [0052].

1010:06E5.name: fast_timer_isr
1010:06E5.notes: Reprogrammed IRQ0 (INT 08h) handler. Loads DS from CS:9596, optionally far-calls sound at 2032:0000 when [0055]&1, calls 1010:D50E, bumps 066B via 066C on even sub-ticks, increments [0054] mod 4, sends EOI to port 20h, and chains the original BIOS INT 08h every 4th tick (jmp far cs:[0738]). Not emulated as an ISR; only the 0679 wait is modelled.

1010:0871.name: runtime_error_print_and_exit_delay
1010:0871.notes: Generic error display path. Reached with DX=0FF6 and stdout "Memory de-allocation error" when PSP AH=4Ah resize failed before checkpoint 8.

1010:2E6E.name: overkill_tandy_masked_sprite_composite_2e6e
1010:2E6E.notes: Mode-2 eight-word masked sprite compositor. For each row it reads mask/data word pairs from DS:SI and writes dest=(dest & mask)|data to ES:DI, then advances DI by 0058h. Restores DS from CS:[9596] and RETs. Verified against interpreted ASM and live Tandy gameplay calls.

1010:2ECB.name: overkill_tandy_or_inverted_mask_2ecb
1010:2ECB.notes: Mode-2/Tandy eight-word inverted-mask OR compositor reached through the 75A6/768E layer sprite path during formation gameplay. Same shape as 2F40 but eight destination words per row and row advance 0058h.

1010:2F40.name: overkill_tandy_or_inverted_mask_2f40
1010:2F40.notes: Mode-2/Tandy four-word layer compositor reached through 768E. For each of 16 rows it reads four source mask words, NOTs each word, ORs it into ES:DI, skips the interleaved source word with SI += 4, advances DI by 2 per word and 0060h per row, restores DS from CS:[9596], and RETs. Added from crash snapshot play_tandy_edrax_orbit_combat_20260611_164810 where A8C7 -> 7596 -> 768E selected 2F40.

1010:2F81.name: overkill_tandy_masked_sprite_composite_2f81
1010:2F81.notes: Mode-2 four-word masked sprite compositor. Same shape as 2E6E with four destination words per row and row advance 0060h. Hottest Tandy first-level sprite composite target; verified against interpreted ASM and live hook verifier.

1010:306F.name: overkill_tandy_rect_copy_306f
1010:306F.notes: Mode-2 raw rectangle copy used by menu/high-score text screens. Reads height/width from DS:SI, copies width*4 bytes per row to CS:[95A4] video memory, advances rows through Tandy +2000h interlace with +80A0h wrap correction, and preserves the balanced PUSH/POP stack scratch.

1010:30D2.name: tandy_object_row_addr_target_30d2
1010:30D2.notes: Mode-2 target reached through 1010:5A36. Maps SS:[BP+02]/SS:[BP+04] to a Tandy work-buffer row address via DS:99C8, stores zero to SS:[BP+12], uses X>>1, returns AX=FFFF for out-of-range/FFFF rows, and optionally decrements SS:[BP+24]. Folded into the verified 5A36 dispatch hook.

1010:33B2.name: overkill_expand_tandy_block_33b2
1010:33B2.notes: Tandy packed-pixel startup block/list continuation. Live-patched routine: if ZF is set it jumps to 44AA; otherwise renders CS:[5B9E] rows by CS:[5B9C] cells via 33DD, advances SI by three extra widths per row, and jumps back to 33AF. Verified hook preserves normal/terminator continuations and final stack scratch.

1010:33DD.name: overkill_expand_tandy_cell_33dd
1010:33DD.notes: Tandy per-cell source expander. Reads four source bytes separated by CS:[5B9C], calls 344B four times, stores temporaries at CS:5B94..5B9B, increments SI, and writes visible/mask words to ES:DI with STOSW depending on CS:[0BD6].

1010:344B.name: tandy_pack_pixels_344b
1010:344B.notes: Tandy packed-pixel helper used by 33DD. ROR/RCL interleaves AL/AH/DL/DH into CL and optionally computes CH mask bytes against CS:[0000] when CS:[0BD6] is nonzero. No EGA colour remap table.

1010:34AD.name: overkill_tandy_split_present_copy_34ad
1010:34AD.notes: Mode-2 split present-side copy reached from 5A92. If entry DI is valid it first calls the verified 34C5 eight-word/16-row copy for SS:[BP+0C]/SS:[BP+0E]. It then loads DI=SS:[BP+10], SI=SS:[BP+0E]+0140h and tail-falls into 34C5 when the second destination is valid. Added while lifting the fail-fast A90F/A927 present-scan path.

1010:34C5.name: overkill_tandy_strided_copy_34c5
1010:34C5.notes: Mode-2 16-row, eight-word DI-strided copy helper. Sets BX=0058/CX=0010, copies eight words per row from DS:SI to ES:DI, advances DI by 0058h after each row, restores DS from CS:[9596], and RETs. Verified against interpreted ASM and live gameplay calls.

1010:34D8.name: overkill_tandy_small_strided_copy_34d8
1010:34D8.notes: Mode-2 present-side fixed block reached from 5A92. If DI=FFFF it returns after CMP; otherwise copies 16 rows of four words from DS:SI to ES:DI and advances DI by 0060h after every row. Live verifier caught the final ADD DI,BX flag/DI effect; hook and oracle now match.

1010:3542.name: overkill_tandy_tiny_strided_copy_3542
1010:3542.notes: Mode-2 tiny present-side copy reached from 5A92 for overlaid/8D12 objects. If DI=FFFF it returns; otherwise it copies 8 rows of two words from DS:SI to ES:DI, advancing DI by 0064h after each row. Added from the fail-fast A90F path where type 0 mode 2 dispatch selected 3542.

1010:35AA.name: overkill_tandy_source_strided_copy_35aa
1010:35AA.notes: Mode-2 source-strided object copy. Loads ES=CS:[9596], DS=CS:[9598], copies 16 rows of eight words, advances SI by 0058h after each row, restores DS from CS:[9596], and RETs. Verified against interpreted ASM and live gameplay calls.

1010:35CC.name: overkill_tandy_draw_object_block_35cc
1010:35CC.notes: Mode-2 draw-side parent block reached from 5AC8. Calls the verified 5A36 row-address hook internally while preserving CALL stack scratch, stores SS:[BP+0C], adds DS:[234C], loads ES=CS:[9596]/DS=CS:[9598], then copies 16 rows of four words advancing SI by 0060h after each row. Verified as a composed parent hook against interpreted ASM and live gameplay calls.

1010:38B7.name: overkill_masked_sprite_composite_38b7
1010:38B7.notes: Masked 2-column sprite-composite LOOP (38B7..38CF). Per row: two columns of [lodsw mask; and ax,es:[di]; or ax,ds:[si]; add si,2; stosw] then add di,0030h; loop CX rows. Effect: dest=(dest AND mask) OR data. Source row=[mask0,data0,mask1,data1] (SI+=8/row); dest stride 0034h. Hottest interpreted routine in the sprite-render phase after the 477E lift. Exit: CX=0, AX=last word, FLAGS from final add di,30h, falls through to 38D0. Replaced and verified bit-identical to the interpreted loop over 2000 randomized states.

1010:41DA.name: overkill_linear_rows_to_work_buffer_41da
1010:41DA.notes: Row-copy routine selected via 5A5A table. Verified hook matches interpreted ASM for captured zero-row/zero-width call. Diagnostic guard now stops on suspicious rows=65536,width=FECE case at DS:SI=7000:550C instead of burning enormous time; this is evidence of either a later data/control-flow issue or an unhandled convention, not treated as understood gameplay logic.

1010:447B.name: overkill_present_frame_blit_447b
1010:447B.notes: Mode-0 frame-present blit, reached via the 5BDC video jump table (CS:[5BE8]). Copies C0h (192) rows of 1Ah (26) words from the work buffer CS:[9598]:[234C] to the display CS:[95A4] (=B800h) using the interlaced scanline step (+2000h/+C050h on the 4000h bank wrap), then restores DS from CS:[9596]. Hottest interpreted loop once the main loop runs; replaced by a verified hook.

1010:450C.name: overkill_expand_4plane_list_450c
1010:450C.notes: Outer list driver for the 4-plane startup renderer: reads block headers via 44D7 semantics and invokes the verified 4511 block renderer until the zero/FFFF exit path to 44AA.

1010:4537.name: overkill_expand_4plane_row_4537_fast
1010:4537.notes: 4-plane row renderer helper; optimized but still verified against interpreted ASM. Mirrors current CPU8086 rotate flag semantics for oracle-relative tests.

1010:477E.name: overkill_sprite_blit_9x16_477e
1010:477E.notes: Fully-unrolled fixed-geometry sprite blit (477E..480D), reached from the 5A36/4740 table dispatcher via the A849 sprite loop. ES=cs:[9596], source DS=cs:[9598]; copies a 9-byte-wide by 16-row sprite from DS:SI (source row stride 52) into packed ES:DI, then restores DS=cs:[9596]. Exit: SI+=0x340, DI+=0x90, 144 bytes written, FLAGS from the final add si,2Bh. Hottest interpreted routine during sprite-heavy loading. Replaced and verified against interpreted ASM (DF=0 and DF=1).
